notes.title: Update 1.2.1
notes.notes:
New

 Blueprint for Big Bank added.


Changes

 The decorations in DEA Office have been updated.
 The camera is now fixed when pressing TAB.


Fixes

 Collider for stairs fixed.
 Guards no longer get stuck when trying to eat or drink.
 "Keycard" Advantage in DEA Office will now be correctly unlocked.

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
New

 "Back to lobby" button added to the pause menu.
 Advantages: advantages can now be purchased at the planning table in the lobby.
 Gadgets (can be placed once with [G]): Camera Jammer, Motion Detector & Mini Camera
 Switchable lights are now available in many rooms.
 4 new skills, two each for flashlight and pings.
 When the police arrive, police cars now actually drive up.
 New Heist: Big Bank (+ 4 new achievements)
 In some heists, there are now civilians that run to the closest guard when they detect a player.
 The brightness can now be adjusted in the settings.
 Added some new sounds. 
 Added Discord rich presence.


Changes

 Removed third camera in the front room of the Jewelry and adjusted spawn chances of the other cameras.
 PC names in Small Bank are now randomized.
 Update to Unity 6.1
 The camera on the top floor of the Small Bank has been moved slightly. (no longer looks directly at the stairs)
 Alarm lights added to the DEA Office.
 The entire UI design has been reworked.
 The scenery in many levels has been reworked and expanded.
 Skill wall in the Lobby has been reworked.
 The selected difficulty is now displayed in the Lobby.
 Light & shadow quality generally adjusted and improved.
 Standard brightness slightly increased.
 Standard flashlight range slightly increased.
 Tutorial has been updated.
 The loot in the DEA Office has been slightly adjusted.


Fixes

 Keyboard sound now stops correctly when hacking is canceled.
 Moved some objects to prevent interaction through the wall.
 Hackable PCs in Small Bank are now correctly synchronized for players who join later.
 Ready zone in the Lobby is now correctly synchronized for players who join later.
 Fixed bug with player cards in the lobby. (Player only visible as "Player Name")
 The evidence room in the DEA Office now have some decorations.
 Loading screen is now deactivated correctly.
 Stamina skill is now applied correctly.
 If the wrong PC is hacked in Small Bank, the correct player name is now displayed in the notification.
 Heist timer is now counted correctly.
 Doors no longer block the field of view of guards or cameras. Also, you can now ping through doors.
 Blueprint for DEA Office is now displayed correctly.
 Guards can now walk through the front door in the Jewelry.
 Added missing collider to certain doors & walls.
 Fixed some graphics bugs (black flickering).

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Additions

 The elevator in the DEA Office heist now has lights.
 Hint arrows added to DEA Office heist.
 Cooldown of pings decreased dramatically.
 Position Pings are now visible through walls and will get bigger the further they are away from the player.


Fixes

 Missing localizations added.
 Level selector (Projector) will now be correctly synced to players that join later.
 Picked up objects will now correctly despawn.
 Fixed problem when player tried to join running heist.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
New

 New heist: DEA Office. (with 4 new achievements)
 Spanish localization
 Ping system: use middle mouse button to ping positions, guards or cameras
 Stamina system: sprinting now costs stamina, but you can now sprint with a bag!


Changes

 Upstairs layout of Jewelry Store heist changed a bit.
 Guards no longer walk behind the containers on Docks Warehouse heist.
 The level calculation has been adjusted. You now need less experience to progress to the next level. (This will subsequently increase your current level)


Fixes

 Fixed buttons for level selector (projector) showing for non host players.
 Fixed some doors on Docks Warehouse heist.
 Fixed ready zone and escape zone not detecting players to already stand in zone once it activates.
 Fixed spawning duplicate loot.
 Fixed difficulty seletor showing for non host players when joining a lobby.
 Fixed money not updating after buying tool.
 Fixed some objectives on Docks Warehouse heist.
 Fixed "Invite" button showing when playing offline.
 Fixed some doors opening in wrong direction.
 Fixed "First try" achievement only unlocking for host.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Changes

 Adjusted detection values of cameras & guards. This should make lower difficulties easier and more forgiving.
 Adjusted collider of fence on Dock Warehouses to make it easier to throw over bags.
 Increased experience reward on higher difficulties.
 Improved scenery of all levels.
 Small adjustments & fixes to localization texts.
 Added interaction time to tool racks to avoid accidental buys.


Fixes

 Fixed freeze/ crash on host when player got detected.
 Fixed interaction text not displaying when looking at certain doors or computers.
 Fixed collider of "Employee of the Month" going through wall.
 Fixed wrong door opening when hacking front door in Small Bank.
 Fixed heist timer sometimes not resetting when restarting the heist.
 Fixed money display in lobby not updating after ending a heist.
 Fixed "Kinky" achievement unlocking for all players.
 Fixed level selector (projector) in lobby not being synced.
 Fixed preview model in wardrobe.
 Fixed front gate in Dock Warehouses always being open.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Changes

 Fixed issue with starting an online lobby right after finishing the tutorial.
 (Potentially) Fixed error when avatar catching fails.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Changes

 Fixed a problem on Small Bank and Docks Warehouses where the objective wouldn't progress correctly.

notes.title: Release Date
notes.notes:
Stealth Strike will be available from 07.04!
Add the game to your wishlist to be notified.

There will probably also be another playtest shortly before the release!
